name: Kisaragi Keigo
source:
Shirogane Academy special curriculum 3rd year high school student.
President of the tea ceremony club.

Special Skills: Language Study, Horse Riding
Favorite Phrase: Soft and Fair Goes Far
Likes: His Collection of Foreign Books (First Editions)
Dislikes: Horse Meat Sashimi (Because it's horse)
